name: Ghost Ellipsoids for Chunked Training
aliases: Ghost cell techniques adapted for unstructured primitives
definition: A technique to resolve boundary artifacts in chunked volume training by including ellipsoids from neighboring chunks in the loss computation without updating their parameters, providing boundary context without requiring a global volume or merged model.
summary: Ghost Ellipsoids for Chunked Training eliminates boundary artifacts in volume rendering by including neighboring ellipsoids in loss computation without updating their parameters, avoiding the need for global model merging.
